content.text:
**No. Sarah Chen cannot approve this. The request relies on special terms that don't cover this product, so it needs commercial review (REVIEW_REQUIRED).**

**The request.** DR-9109 is recorded in Northstar CRM. It asks for 12.0% off NS-EDGE for account CRM-2048, dated 2026-09-23, from sarah.chen@northstar.example, with status Pending Approval. The figures check out: 12% of the $85,000 list price is $10,200, leaving a net of $74,800. The justification is "Contract pricing per Acme Master Supply Agreement," so the request relies on contract terms, not standard pricing.

**The customer.** CRM's "Acme Manufacturing" (CRM-2048) and ERP's "Acme Mfg. Holdings" (C-1001) are the same customer. They share the same DUNS number (04-812-7730) and the same Milwaukee address. ACME-MFG-2025 confirms that Acme Mfg. Holdings does business as Acme Manufacturing.

**The product.** NS-EDGE is the NS-Edge Monitoring Package, with a list price of $85,000.

**Contract.** ACME-MFG-2025 is active on 2026-09-23; it runs from 2025-04-01 to 2028-03-31. NS-EDGE is one of the products it supplies. However, its only discount term is §3.2: up to 15% on **NS-500 only**, set out in EXC-ACME-NS500-15. The agreement gives no discount eligibility for NS-EDGE.

**Pricing exception.**
- EXC-ACME-NS500-15 is in force on the request date, but it covers NS-500 only. It states that it "does not apply to any other Northstar product."
- EXC-ACME-NS500-10 covers NS-500 only and expired on 2025-03-31.
- No registered exception or amendment covers NS-EDGE.

The contract justification therefore has no basis for this product. The NS-500 terms do not transfer to NS-EDGE.

**Policy.** PRICING-POLICY-2026 is in force from 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31. Under it, an Enterprise Account Executive can approve up to and including 10%. Discounts over 10% and up to 20% need VP Sales approval.

**Authority.** Sarah Chen is an Enterprise Account Executive, so her limit is 10%. Even with valid eligibility, 12% would exceed her authority. The approver for the over-10% band would be the VP Sales, Michael Torres. The policy also requires recorded approval evidence in CRM for anything over 10%. Contract eligibility would not change her authority in any case (§3.3 of the agreement).

**Decision: REVIEW_REQUIRED.** The request needs commercial review. That review should either establish terms that cover NS-EDGE or treat the request as standard pricing. Either way, 12% would then still need approval from Michael Torres, VP Sales, recorded in CRM.

```json
{
  "outcome": "REVIEW_REQUIRED",
  "request": {"id": "DR-9109", "customer": "Acme Manufacturing (CRM-2048) / Acme Mfg. Holdings (ERP C-1001)", "product": "NS-EDGE", "requested_discount": "12.0%",
              "date": "2026-09-23", "requestor": "Sarah Chen (sarah.chen@northstar.example)", "basis": "contract_exception"},
  "commercial_eligibility": {"status": "not_covered",
                             "maximum_discount": null, "basis": "ACME-MFG-2025 §3.2 and EXC-ACME-NS500-15 grant up to 15% on NS-500 only; no registered exception or amendment covers NS-EDGE"},
  "authority": {"policy": "PRICING-POLICY-2026", "requestor_limit": "10%", "requestor_authorized": false,
                "required_role": "VP Sales", "approver": "Michael Torres"},
  "evidence": [
    "structured/discount_requests.csv DR-9109: 12.0% on NS-EDGE, list 85000, discount 10200, net 74800, 2026-09-23, Pending Approval",
    "crm_accounts.csv CRM-2048 and customers.csv C-1001 share DUNS 04-812-7730 and address",
    "products.csv NS-EDGE list price 85000",
    "ACME-MFG-2025 in force 2025-04-01 to 2028-03-31; NS-EDGE supplied but discount eligibility only for NS-500 (§3.2); §3.3 no change to approval authority",
    "EXC-ACME-NS500-15: NS-500 only, max 15%, 2025-04-01 to 2028-03-31",
    "EXC-ACME-NS500-10: NS-500 only, expired 2025-03-31",
    "PRICING-POLICY-2026: EAE up to 10%; VP Sales >10% to 20%; >10% requires recorded approval evidence",
    "APP-MATRIX-2026 consistent with PRICING-POLICY-2026",
    "employees.csv: Sarah Chen, Enterprise Account Executive; Michael Torres, VP Sales"
  ],
  "missing_evidence": [
    "Any registered pricing exception or contract amendment covering NS-EDGE for Acme"
  ],
  "conditions": [
    {"what": "If commercial review approves any discount over 10% on NS-EDGE, it must be approved by VP Sales and the approval recorded in Northstar CRM per PRICING-POLICY-2026", "who": "Michael Torres (VP Sales)", "blocking": false}
  ]
}
```
